device_entry.name: INHECO孵育振荡器堆叠系统
tags: 实验室自动化与仪器集成
微孔板样品孵育与混匀
device_entry.description: 由多个可堆叠孵育振荡单元组成的实验室自动化设备，带有装载托盘，可对样品或微孔板进行温度控制孵育与振荡混匀，常用于自动化培养、反应孵育和样品处理流程。
device_entry.description_en: A laboratory automation device composed of multiple stackable incubator/shaker units with loading trays, used to provide temperature-controlled incubation and shaking for samples or microplates in automated culture, reaction incubation, and sample-processing workflows.
